tools.name: scam_check
tools.description: Check a Base token (0x address) or URL for scam and rug risk before buying, or a wallet against the sanctions, USDC-blacklist and known-scam-deployer lists. Returns action OK | CAUTION | AVOID | VERIFY_MORE with the facts behind it and a ready-to-show summary. null means unknown, never safe. Free: 1

tools.name: endpoint_check
tools.description: Check whether an x402 endpoint is safe to pay: it looks at what the endpoint asks you to pay and to whom and compares that with its history. It never pays the endpoint. Unreachable endpoints and bad input are not charged. Free: 1 a day per IP (counted across the HTTP routes and MCP), then $0.005 per

tools.name: verify_payment
tools.description: Verify an on-chain payment from its transaction hash on Base, Ethereum, Arbitrum, Solana or Bitcoin (chain is detected if omitted). Returns status and verified. pending, unknown and not_found answers are not charged. Free: 1 a day per IP (counted across the HTTP routes and MCP), then $0.003 per call
